offering_description.value: Regulated water utility that supplies treated drinking water and provides wastewater collection and treatment to homes, businesses and municipalities in Delaware, Maryland and Pennsylvania. It draws water from wells, treats it, and delivers it through its own pipe networks, earning regulated rates for metered use.

primary_services.value: wastewater collection and treatment; water service line protection plans

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential homeowners and households; B2B: commercial and industrial water users; B2G: municipalities and local government water systems

end_markets.value: residential water; commercial and industrial water; wastewater; municipal utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered charges for water delivered to customers; service fees: wastewater service charges and homeowner service line protection plans
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs wells, treatment plants and distribution and collection networks, sells water and wastewater service to end customers; service provider: provides wastewater and related utility services to customers and municipalities

geography_served.value: US regional: Delaware, Maryland and Pennsylvania

specialization.value: related lines: water supply, wastewater service and homeowner service line protection

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct billing of residential, commercial and municipal customers through its own utility operations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: regulated utility rates and service approvals from the Delaware, Maryland and Pennsylvania public utility commissions, plus drinking water and wastewater rules
